messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty page fired for service: inference-eu (high-latency) — priority: P1. Trigger: 5xx spike + tail latency > 1s across pods. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-12345

PagerDutyBot: Alert details: events=34 last=2025-06-12T14:03:43Z

Alex K: ack'd. I'm taking this.

Maria V: on standby — running runbook checks

Alex K: quick summary: dashboards show 95th token latency jump on model kvcache hosts in eu-west-1. Errors predominantly 504 streaming timeouts. Rolling deploy 14:59 UTC may correlate.

Jamal R: can you check router logs? I saw a routing config flip ~15:00 in staging yesterday but not prod. I'll pull logs now.

Alex K: starting mitigation: scale dedicated pool 'inference-eu-high' +20% and disable canary rollout for model v2.5. Command:
```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool inference-eu-high --delta 4
redwoodctl rollout pause --model v2.5
```

Sophie L: scaling kicked off, +4 nodes, estimated spin up 90s.

Jamal R: router logs: saw increased 502s from a subset of edge proxies 10.4.2.* — pushing a traffic split rollback to 90/10 to fallback pool.

Alex K: rollback applied, verifying. Also enabling extra KV cache retention (prefix cache) to reduce recompute.

Maria V: customer-impact: some customers reported degraded response and aborted streams. No data loss. CS alerted.

Sophie L: nodes healthy, tail latencies dropping. 95th went from 1.8s -> 0.6s in last 60s.

Alex K: good progress. Keeping ownership. Will monitor for 15 more mins then coordinate canary re-enable.

Jamal R: logging an incident note: possible scheduler bug on canary that increased connection churn. Filing issue #INC-7812.

IncidentBot: PagerDuty: to be resolved if no further alerts for 10m.

Alex K: status ping — 15:15 UTC, service stable, mitigation successful, marking as 'monitoring'. I'll hand off to Sophie for postmortem and runbook update.

Sophie L: acknowledged handoff. I'll own the follow-up and postmortem. :thumbsup:

PagerDutyBot: Incident acknowledged by Alex K; handoff to Sophie L recorded.
